name: pilot-10k-16384
description: Exploratory ceiling probe: 10,240 requested input tokens with a 16384-token output ceiling. The 8192 pilot completed 20 of 20 naturally, but the next 20-request cell censored 2 reasoning-only responses at 8192. This cell asks whether those outliers terminate by 16384. 16384 is a declared probe value, not a provider-verified output limit. A clean result does not certify the ceiling and does not authorize a multiwindow run.

qualification.note: Exploratory ceiling evidence only. It is excluded from future qualification evidence and cannot qualify an endpoint.
